sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be 
 performed every one year as indicated by (Y1) in the above title block.

This pump is used to transfer all clarifiers and thickeners drains from the 
 manhole to the waste pit .

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Mageed Elhenawy, tested at 
 September 2008 , revised by MDEPCo. Quality control Eng. Magdy Hegazy, accepted by 
 eng . Magdy Okba, and approved by eng . Ahmed Abdel Mageed Sowan Nubaria head 
 sector

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality 
 control general Manager& MPIS coordinator, and certified by Eng Mohamed Nageeb 
 inspection & quality control's head sector.
